# openstatus_notification (Data Source)

Fetches an existing OpenStatus notification channel by ID. Returns notification metadata without provider-specific configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openstatus_notification" "slack" {
  id = "789"
}

output "notification_provider" {
  value = data.openstatus_notification.slack.provider_type
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the notification.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Display name of the notification channel.
- `provider_type` (String) Notification provider type.
- `monitor_ids` (Set of String) Set of associated monitor IDs.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the notification was created.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the notification was last updated.
